title: Open price for counter trades with excess collateral calculated wrongly
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `openTradeMarketCallback` function opens trades with the `openPrice` (L102) that is calculated based on the price impact that the trade would cause on the market.
